verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an observability and incident-management SaaS like Better Stack, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents an MCP server, a REST API with curl examples, and Terraform, but none of it mentions an official command-line tool. Those are adjacent integration surfaces, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
